name: Neighbor Cell Access via Hash Table and Morton Code
definition: A method to find face-adjacent cells in an irregular octree using spatial coordinates, Morton codes, and a hash table for constant-time access. It handles anisotropic subdivision by checking geometric limits to ensure true adjacency.
summary: Neighbor Cell Access via Hash Table and Morton Code retrieves face-adjacent cells in irregular octrees by combining hash lookups with geometric limit validation to ensure correctness where standard Morton arithmetic fails.
